Subject: Update: Schedule Change for Upcoming Workshop

Dear Participants,

We look forward to welcoming you to our upcoming workshop. Please note a quick update regarding our schedule: we have moved the hands-on practical session to the afternoon to allow for more interactive discussion. 

Registration will still open promptly at 8:45 AM, and our morning sessions will begin at 9:00 AM. A complimentary lunch will be provided for all attendees during the midday break. 

As a reminder, please bring your laptop and charger, as you will need them for the afternoon's practical activities. 

Thank you for your flexibility, and please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,

The Workshop Organizing Team
task: Write a professional email explaining a fictional workshop schedule change: the practical session moves to the afternoon, registration remains at 8:45, lunch is included, and participants should bring laptops.
